- Implement read receipts (blue ticks) efficiently.

- Queue messages for offline users with ordering guarantees.
- Sync phone contacts to find WhatsApp users.
- Should auto-expire after TYPING_TIMEOUT

- Return: [{phone, user_id, profile_pic, status}]
